title: The beach tree you should never sit under
chunks: Here's what that band is for.
so you shelter under the leaves.
Each one holds a milky sap,

beats.tree: Finn walks across the sand toward the only tree
beats.manchineel: cut: the camera rises up the trunk into the crown
beats.band: push-in on the red painted band
beats.storm: cut: dark sky, rain; Finn runs under the tree
beats.sap: white drops gather on the leaves
beats.blisters: close-up: red spots pop out on his face, he winces
beats.starving: Finn holds his belly, looks up at an apple
beats.bite: he bites the apple and smiles
beats.burns: his eyes go wide, hands at his throat, sweat drop
beats.spanish: cut: high-angle insert of the bitten apple on the sand
beats.death: a small crab scuttles away from the apple
beats.later: cut: Finn tiptoes behind a boulder
beats.grab: he grabs a bunch of leaves
beats.worse: he shoots up from behind the boulder and hops away
beats.see: he squeezes his eyes shut and gropes with both arms
beats.sit: cut: daylight, Finn sits in the sand far from the tree
beats.subscribe: subscribe button pops in, Finn looks up
beats.warnings: the bell rings; Finn stands back where he started
